verdict: Yes, with a clear design or price edge. Hammer Lifestyle from Panipat pitched smart audio products on Shark Tank India Season 1 and got a deal. Earbuds and speakers are huge categories in India, but boAt, Noise and many others compete on price.
angle: Young buyers buy earbuds, neckbands and speakers often. Most brands source from the same factories, so design, sound tuning and service are what set you apart. Marketplaces and creators drive sales.
